 Get A REAL ID, Vehicle Registration, & More During Long Valley MVC Mobile Visit
 Residents can renew driver's licenses, obtain REAL IDs and access other motor vehicle services without traveling to an MVC agency.
 Jack Slocum , Patch Staff 
 Posted Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 3:06 pm ET LONG VALLEY, NJ — Washington Township residents looking to take care of motor vehicle paperwork without visiting an MVC agency will have an opportunity later this month.
 The New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission's (MVC) mobile unit will visit the Washington Township Community Center, located at 35 East Springtown Road in Long Valley, on Nov. 17, from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
 The mobile unit, described as an "agency-on-wheels," offers several services typically available at MVC locations.
 Find out what's happening in Long Valley for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . According to the MVC, available services include:
 Driver's licenses: Renewals, duplicate licenses, name and address changes, boat endorsements, and veteran designations.
 REAL ID: REAL ID services for a limited number of customers. Those with REAL ID appointments must arrive by 11:30 a.m.
 Vehicle registrations: Registration renewals and duplicate registration cards.
 Non-driver identification cards: Photo identification for residents who do not have driver's licenses.
 License plates: Surrendering license plates.
 Disability placards: Placards for people with disabilities, Purple Heart recipients, and disabled veterans.
 Examination permits: Applications for permits to take written knowledge tests. The tests themselves will not be administered at the mobile unit.
 Residents can also register to vote and make organ donation selections through certain driver's license services.
 Find out what's happening in Long Valley for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . The mobile unit is wheelchair accessible.
 Appointments can be scheduled in advance. Residents should check the township's event announcement for the appointment link.
 The MVC notes that mobile unit visits may be canceled because of weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances.
 For more information about MVC services, visit NJMVC.gov .
